    sns\_topic = Amazon\_SNS\_Topic\_\_3\_0\_0\_\_retrievewithwhere\_Topic(topics\_topicarn\_0, topics\_topicarn\_1)

    if sns\_topic:
        # Create a ServiceNow incident for the SNS topic
        service\_now\_incident = ServiceNow\_incident\_\_4\_0\_0\_\_create\_incident(sns\_topic)
